newsitem.title: UK: UK Forties Oct loadings up eight at 54.3 cargoes.
newsitem.headline: UK Forties Oct loadings up eight at 54.3 cargoes.

text.p: October's North Sea Forties blend crude programme will consist of the equivalent of 54.3 standard 500,000-barrel cargoes, including the equivalent of three shipments direct to operator BP's Grangemouth refinery, traders said on Friday.
The October programme is just over eight cargoes higher than September's 46.2-cargo programme.

The October programme totals 27.17 million barrels, made up of 24 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, 17 of 500,0000 barrels, two of 650,000 barrels, one each of 800,000 and 620,000 barrels and 1.55 milion barrels to the Forties system operator BP's refinery.
September's total was 23.1 million barrels, including 1.5 million to Grangemouth.
"It's hardly surprising. Quite a few fields are performing much better again," said a trader.
September volumes were also depressed by maintenance at Enterprise Oil's Nelson field.
Forties cargoes are loaded from the Hound Point terminal in eastern Scotland.
